summary.method: Per-wine web search restricted to vivino.com (brand + wine name), then a read of each candidate wine page: rating, rating count, title, winery, grapes and region from the page header and facts. A match is kept only when the page names the same producer and the same wine as the Whole Foods listing (build/vivino_fetch_to_extract.py), and the search did not doubt the cuvee. The grapes listing was used to learn the site structure, not crawled. robots.txt-disallowed paths (/reviews/, /users/) were not visited. Word clouds come from the first page (up to 10) of each wine's public reviews JSON (/api/wines/<id>/reviews, not disallowed by robots.txt): descriptor terms per English review, counted in code. Review texts, reviewer names and profiles are never stored.
summary.reviews_note: Only term counts are kept; see reviews_counted and word_cloud per wine.
